thread:
maria: Alert: discovered ~1.2k DB snapshot objects in prod without SSE headers under redwood-db-snapshots/snapshots/2026-06-12/. No x-amz-server-side-encryption present.
security-bot: [alert] object-store:put-no-sse detected for snapshots/2026-06-12/ — alert AS-2026-900. https://alerts.redwood.internal/AS-2026-900
aj: Can you paste a HEAD for one object? need to confirm whether metadata stripped or never set.
maria: sample HEAD:\n```\nContent-Length: 157286400\nx-amz-meta-origin: backup-service\nx-amz-server-side-encryption: <absent>\n```
luca: We merged an uploader metadata refactor last night (PR #5432) that deferred SSE injection until after multipart-complete. Possible race.
aj: CloudTrail shows 1,216 CompleteMultipartUpload/PutObject events for that prefix between 02:12-02:40Z from role arn:aws:iam::0123456789:role/svc-uploader-role. No kms:GrantTokens in call context.
erin: Compliance note: if objects were stored unencrypted even briefly, we need timeline and tenant mapping for notifications.
sam-oncall: Immediate mitigations: 1) apply deny bucket policy for PutObject when s3:x-amz-server-side-encryption != aws:kms on that prefix; 2) or revoke svc-uploader-role PutObject on the bucket. Which is faster?
luca: Bucket policy is quick but broad. Revoke role for the uploader principal scoped to that bucket is surgical. I'll prepare both; prefer revoke then policy if we see other writers fail.
aj: Exporting affected keys and tenant IDs now; will attach CSV to incident doc.
maria: Any KMS grant changes recently? We shortened ephemeral grant TTL for uploads to 90s last week as an experiment.
luca: I don't see KMS errors in CloudWatch. Looks like metadata addition step skipped, not a grant failure.
aj: Re-encryption approach: copy objects in-place with --metadata-directive REPLACE and --sse aws:kms --sse-kms-key-id alias/redwood-cmk. For multipart objects we must use multipart-copy to preserve integrity.
maria: Also need to check cross-region replication & any downstream mirrors. aj?
aj: CRR disabled for that prefix, no replication detected.
erin: Drafting notification template; will wait for CSV to determine which tenants need direct notification per contract.
security-bot: Incident created INC-2026-900, severity=P1, responders=@maria @aj @luca @sam-oncall @erin
sam-oncall: Revoked svc-uploader-role PutObject on redwood-db-snapshots at 03:50Z. Applying short deny policy to snapshots/2026-06-12/* as backup.
luca: Hotfix: reverting metadata refactor to ensure SSE header is set before multipart complete. Pushing branch and adding integration tests that assert x-amz-server-side-encryption present on complete.
aj: Uploaded CSV (object_key, size, put_timestamp, uploader_principal) to incident doc and started checksum validation on a 10-object sample.
maria: Post-incident actions:
- add bucket-level deny for missing SSE on all snapshot prefixes
- add Athena alert for PutObject where x-amz-server-side-encryption IS NULL
- add CI integration test covering SSE injection and multipart flow
- review ephemeral KMS grant TTL experiment and roll back if needed
- update runbook for unencrypted-upload incidents

luca: Tested re-encrypt dry-run on a sample object:\n```\naws s3 cp s3://redwood-db-snapshots/snapshots/2026-06-12/snap-0001 \\ 
  s3://redwood-db-snapshots/snapshots/2026-06-12/snap-0001 \\ 
  --metadata-directive REPLACE --sse aws:kms --sse-kms-key-id alias/redwood-cmk\n```\nNote: multipart-copy needed for multipart objects.
aj: Verified sample re-encrypt checksums match expected after multipart-copy. Recording pre/post ETag and sizes in incident doc.
erin: Preparing customer notification list and legal review. Will flag any contracts requiring immediate disclosure.
maria: Good work. Keep this thread as the coordination channel. Paste any blocking errors here. :thumbsup:
